Pastor Zachary ('Zacarias') Anderson and his wife Sandra served in ministry for over thirty years before being called to Mexico, where they established the congregation in 2010; the church publishes the 'El Mesias' podcast and goes by PCPV (pcpv.net). The phone number carried in the old record, (052) 322 224 1869, is a Mexican number - country code 52, area code 322 = Puerto Vallarta - and the website column held a block of prose rather than a URL. Since this directory covers US congregations, the record does not belong; flagged rather than deleted pending a Report-FK check and user sign-off.
